1. Case overview

Summary. Seven plans compare six DMAT modulation variants with one TB_VMAT reference. Saved comparative scores range from 7.883 to 9.177 out of 10; delivery durations range from 25.5 to 183.8 seconds. Individual target and organ-at-risk endpoints are shown alongside the aggregate score.

Clinical background and rationale. This cervix / GYN case compares plans for a 45 Gy prescription delivered in 25 fractions to PTV_45. The comparison examines how modulation changes target coverage, bladder, rectum and bowel dose, and delivery duration under the recorded planning setup.

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. DMAT: 10FFF, 1 arc; modulation -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: TB_VMAT: 10FFF, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. 25 provided goals per DMAT plan. Goal thresholds and priorities are listed in the planning tables; derived and supporting objectives are separate. Example from DA255: Bowel D0.03 cm3 < 47.25 Gy (P1.1). Comparative scoring uses the saved custom scorecard, “ATRIA - Cervix Trial”, with 26 endpoints covering target dose and coverage, bladder, rectum, bowel, femoral heads and Inner_Ring. Saved thresholds, score curves and achieved values are retained in Scorecard details.

Comparison methods. Compared the dose colorwash, DVHs, quality–time graph and individual endpoint–time graphs. Dose normalization factors: 1. DMAT: Matched delivery metrics; TB_VMAT: RT Plan control-point estimate. Durations do not represent total room time.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
15 GyRx 45 Gy49.5 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA255’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 15–49.5 Gy color scale.

Scoring method

Imported or selected score curves, weights, and thresholds are retained. The traffic-light summary classifies evaluated values as goal, variation, or deviation; missing or unmapped endpoints contribute zero points. Native technical-report compliance scores remain separate.
